title: A reaction-diffusion system with nonconstant diffusion coefficients: exact and numerical solutions
summary: A Lotka-Volterra type system with porous diffusion, which can be used as an alternative model to the classical Lotka-Volterra system, is under study. Multiparameter families of exact solutions of the system in question are constructed and their properties are established. It is shown that the solutions obtained can satisfy the zero Neumann conditions, which are typical conditions for mathematical models describing real-world processes.
